translations.从月地检验到扭秤: From the Moon–Earth test to the torsion balance
translations.微弱的引力，怎样成为可测量的量？: How can weak gravitation become measurable?
translations.比较月球加速度、扭秤的微小转角和牛顿大炮的绕地轨迹。: Compare lunar acceleration, torsion deflection and Newton’s orbital cannon.

cues.title: 把地面引力延伸到月球
cues.titleEn: Extend Earth’s gravity to the Moon
cues.caption: 距离约增为60倍，加速度约减为3600分之一。
cues.captionEn: At about sixty Earth radii, acceleration is about one thirty-six-hundredth.
cues.zh: 月球到地心的距离约为地球半径的六十倍。如果同一种引力按距离平方减弱，月球处的加速度就应约为地面的三千六百分之一。上方距离和天体大小没有按同一比例绘制；下方比较相同下落距离需要的时间，不表示月球真的向地面直线落下。
cues.en: The Moon is about sixty Earth radii from Earth’s centre. If the same gravity weakens with distance squared, its acceleration there is about one thirty-six-hundredth of surface gravity. Bodies and distances above are not drawn to one scale. The lower comparison concerns local falling distances, not a straight lunar fall to Earth.

cues.title: 用轨道数据独立核对
cues.caption: 由周期和半径算出的向心加速度，与预测接近。
cues.captionEn: Centripetal acceleration from radius and period agrees approximately with the prediction.
cues.zh: 再从月球公转的半径和周期，独立计算所需的向心加速度。它与按平方反比推算的数值接近。左边一秒下落约四点九米，右边在月球距离处六十秒偏离切线的距离也接近这个量。月球轨道用圆周近似，真实轨道偏心和太阳摄动在这里省略。
cues.en: Independently calculate centripetal acceleration from the Moon’s orbital radius and period. It agrees approximately with the inverse-square prediction. A one-second surface fall is about four-point-nine metres; the local departure from a tangent over sixty seconds at lunar distance is similar. Eccentricity and solar perturbations are omitted.

cues.title: 用细丝承接微弱力矩
cues.titleEn: Let a fine fibre respond to weak torque
cues.caption: 大球的引力使小球转动，细丝提供反向恢复力矩。
cues.captionEn: Attractor masses turn the small masses while the fibre supplies restoring torque.
cues.zh: 两颗小球固定在轻杆两端，细丝悬挂在杆的中心。大球放到两侧后，四组球之间的引力共同产生力矩，杆缓慢转动。读数在下方放大显示。模型逐对计算引力和力矩，再积分带阻尼的扭转运动；器材尺寸和阻尼是教学选值，不复刻原装置。
cues.en: Two small masses sit at the ends of a light rod suspended by a fine fibre. Forces from both large masses create a net torque and the rod turns slowly. The readout below is enlarged. Pairwise gravitational forces drive a damped torsional model; dimensions and damping are illustrative rather than an exact historical replica.

cues.title: 换位后，转向也改变
cues.titleEn: Swap the attractors and reverse the deflection
cues.caption: 对称换位让引力力矩反向，可帮助区分信号与固定偏差。
cues.captionEn: A symmetric swap reverses gravitational torque and helps distinguish fixed offsets.
cues.zh: 把大球换到相反的位置，力矩方向反转，小球向另一侧偏转。这里每段都从初始静止状态重新释放，以便比较两次记录。卡文迪许的历史目标是测量地球平均密度；现代教学常用同类实验求引力常量。不能把今天的参数和求解形式当成他的原始读数。
cues.en: Moving the attractors to opposite positions reverses the torque. Each segment restarts from rest to compare two records. Cavendish’s historical goal was Earth’s mean density; modern versions often determine the gravitational constant. Present-day parameters and calculations are not his original readings.

cues.title: 先看较慢的水平发射
cues.titleEn: Begin with a slower horizontal launch
cues.caption: 引力不断改变速度方向，轨迹最终与地表相交。
cues.captionEn: Gravity continually turns velocity until the trajectory meets the surface.
cues.zh: 想象在没有空气的地球上方水平发射一个物体。速度较小时，它的弯曲轨迹会与地面相交。画面从三百千米高度出发，只是牛顿思想实验的数值版本，并非可以建造的高山大炮。引力始终指向地心，大小随距离改变。
cues.en: Imagine launching horizontally above an airless Earth. At a lower speed, the curved path intersects the surface. This numerical thought experiment starts at three hundred kilometres altitude; it is not a buildable mountain cannon. Gravity always points toward Earth’s centre and varies with distance.

cues.title: 提高横向速度，落下却绕过地球
cues.titleEn: Increase tangential speed and keep falling around Earth
cues.caption: 轨道运动仍是自由落体，引力没有消失。
cues.captionEn: Orbital motion remains free fall; gravity has not disappeared.
cues.zh: 把初速度调到这一高度的圆轨道速度，物体一边落下一边绕过弯曲地表，持续处于自由落体。绿色短线指向地心，表示加速度方向。自由探索可以继续改变速度，看落地、近圆和椭圆路径；轨迹由同一个中心引力模型积分，预览时长有限。
cues.en: Set the speed to the circular-orbit value at this altitude. The object falls while continually missing the curved surface. The short green line indicates acceleration toward the centre. Exploration changes speed between impact, near-circular and elliptical paths, all integrated from central gravity over a finite preview interval.
